_comment: 最终航行「还剩下什么」+ 四个结局 + 人物短尾声（剧情姐合订稿 in1030/yun1.txt 第 153–240 行）。入口 start_final。通讯器：休息空隙妮芙·河岸来消息（final_msg_nifu_1/2）；结局一 phone_draft「我找到大象了。」（发送设 sent_found）；结局一~三和母星尾声 phone_open friend。燃料界面（todo_mechanic final_flight）选中一件纪念品时播 look_<id>，确认转化后播 burn_<id>（设 burned_<id>）。结局由两次 pick 决定（final_action：下降 / 漂行=结局四；final_nav：旧货场=一、东侧低鸣=二、居民区=三），设 final_ending_1..4；结局里的动作和尾声按 burned_* / final_seed_planted / 森林 returned_all、returned_any、saw_rock 分支。if / goto 是跳转（不返回）。带 added 的是补写。终章引擎（10-31）：结局一、二都在芦苇地 reed_field（yard_* 在西半边、east_* 在东半边，写的是房间 x，美术定了再挪）；尾声森林的 forest_* 是森林的世界 x（树屋那一段），treehouse_* / forest_treehouse 写成第一章 marker 的名字（别名）；rooms 里的 river_bank 只为妮芙家这间小屋有地方放（小屋的 host）。两次 pick 带 ui（cockpit_nav.gd：二次确认、导航屏三个点）。

Plant the seed in the damp soil
Ask where to plant the seed
Go to where the elephant drinks
Plant the seed in the flower bed
Back to the ship, note the location

objectives.zh: 去广场外的花圃种种子
objectives.en: Plant the seed in the bed outside the plaza
Go to the end of the cloud pier
Go round the other side of the fountain

lines.en: Niff's still waiting for me to finish.

lines.zh: 指示牌指着大象喝水的地方。
lines.en: The sign points to where the elephant drinks.

lines.zh: 住处再往外，还有一段云台。
lines.en: Past the lodging, there's a pier out into the clouds.

start_final.zh: 差不多就这样，你又不会告状。
start_final.en: Close enough. Not like you'll tell on me.

final_niff_msg_b.zh: 阿汀让我提醒你，到地方记得晾浮筒哦。
final_niff_msg_b.en: Ting says to remind you: dry out the floats when you land.

reply.en: Got it. I'll dry them when I land.

final_niff_msg_b.zh: 维修：到地方先晾浮筒（阿汀说的）。
final_niff_msg_b.en: Repairs: dry the floats first thing after landing (Ting said).

final_route.spec: 接近云层星的航道比旧记录复杂。碎石带向外扩展，稳定气流只剩几条窄路，玩家需要综合运用声音辨向、避障和修补。正确操作能减少燃料损耗，此前多收集的材料也在这里发挥作用。操作与准备能省下一部分材料，剩余航程仍需要玩家从纪念品中作出取舍。

cab_count.en: Fuel locker: river water, seed, copper bell...

cab_think.zh: 大象我还是想找，消息也还是想等。
cab_think.en: I still want to find the elephant. And I still want to wait for that message.

options.en: Just get through the next stretch.
Let me count again.
I still want to keep these.

narr.zh: 仪表盘：燃料不足。纸质物品可用。
narr.en: Gauge: fuel low. Paper items can be burned.

final_paper.spec: 【最终航行：将听声避障、简短修补和燃料选择结合。选择物品时飞机进入稳定航行状态，玩家可以阅读说明、最后播放声音或取消选择。确认转化后消耗所选物品，其余纪念品保留。列表仅显示当前持有的物品。】（剧本约定：可以做成 flight1 的 keepsake_choice 加多选 / 可退出；选中一件时播 look_<物品id>，确认转化后播 burn_<物品id>；蓝色石头 / 通勤卡剩下的那件用 burn_final_<id>。）
final_paper.spec_journal_rule: 【日记首页为始终保留的剧情物件，不计入可转化燃料。日记首页在所有物品选择及四个结局中均予保留，“我一定要找到大象，因为”后面始终空着，页面仅供查看。】

narr.zh: 瓶子上的标签：「晨来过的那条河」
narr.en: The label on the bottle: "The river Chen came to"

narr.zh: 瓶子上的标签：「寄件人：妮芙」
narr.en: The label on the bottle: "Sender: Niff"

narr.zh: 纸条背面：「没长出来不一定是你的问题。」
narr.en: On the back of the note: "If it doesn't sprout, it isn't necessarily your fault."

look_elephant_footage.zh: 路线抄下来了，可这个声音抄不下来。
look_elephant_footage.en: I copied down the route. Not the sound.

narr.zh: 铃上的标签：「已经送给晨，不用还」
narr.en: The tag on the bell: "Given to Chen. No need to return it."

look_journal.zh: 这一路的事，都记在这本里。
look_journal.en: Everything from this trip is in here.

narr.zh: 第一页：「我一定要找到大象，因为」
narr.en: The first page: "I have to find the elephant, because"

look_footprint_rubbing.zh: 我的手，妮芙的脚，还有它的。
look_footprint_rubbing.en: My hand, Niff's foot. And its.

look_home_photo.en: The arrows and notes are still there.

look_species_query.en: "Not found." It's been tucked under the drawing all along.

look_postcard.zh: 弥洛给的明信片，地址已经抄好了。
look_postcard.en: Milo's postcard. I've already copied the address.

look_final_blue_stone.zh: 小时候，我一直说它会发光。
look_final_blue_stone.en: When I was little, I swore it glowed.

look_seat_chart.en: The seats that get the sun.

narr.zh: 仪表盘：下降仍需更多燃料。
narr.en: Gauge: more fuel needed for descent.

narr.zh: 画背面写着：「下次一起去看看云层里的大象」
narr.en: On the back of the drawing: "Next time, let's go see the elephant in the clouds together"

final_approach.zh: 我一直觉得，找到大象，再收到她的消息，前面这些就都好说了。
final_approach.en: I always thought that once I found the elephant and heard from her, everything before would sort itself out.

narr.zh: 第一页：「我一定要找到大象，因为」
narr.en: The first page: "I have to find the elephant, because"

lines.zh: 可大象就算在那儿，她也不一定回我啊。
lines.en: But even if the elephant's there, she might not write back.

final_action.spec: 【行动选择：继续投入物品，进入下降航道；或关闭主推进器，进入安全漂行轨道。此处为实际行动选择，不同于此前会汇合的普通对话选项。进入安全漂行轨道触发结局四。确认下降后，进入下方的最终导航选择。】

label.zh: 继续投入物品，进入下降航道
label.en: Burn more, enter the descent lane

confirm.zh: 进入下降航道，还要继续投入物品。确定吗？
confirm.en: Enter the descent lane? More items will have to go in.

label.zh: 关闭主推进器，进入安全漂行轨道
label.en: Cut the main thruster, enter a safe drift orbit

confirm.zh: 关闭主推进器，进入安全漂行轨道。确定吗？
confirm.en: Cut the main thruster and enter a safe drift orbit?

narr.zh: 导航屏：西侧旧货场，运输船号对上了。
narr.en: Nav screen: old freight yard to the west. The cargo ship number matches.

narr.zh: 导航屏：东侧有低鸣，声源无法确定。
narr.en: Nav screen: a low rumble to the east. Source unknown.

final_descend.zh: 广场附近有大型动物停留，请居民注意避让。
final_descend.en: A large animal is lingering near the plaza. Residents, please keep clear.

final_descend.spec: 【最终导航选择：前往西侧旧货场，触发结局一；朝东侧低鸣的位置降落，触发结局二；接受城市引导，前往居民区，触发结局三。选择后显示确认提示。普通对话选项不参与结局判定，保留的物品只影响结局中的具体动作与人物尾声。】

label.en: Head west to the old freight yard

confirm.zh: 降落点：西侧旧货场。确定吗？
confirm.en: Landing site: the old freight yard, west. Confirm?

label.zh: 朝东侧低鸣的位置降落
label.en: Land toward the low rumble in the east

confirm.zh: 降落点：东侧低鸣处。声源无法确定。确定吗？
confirm.en: Landing site: the low rumble, east. Source unknown. Confirm?

label.zh: 接受城市引导，前往居民区
label.en: Follow city guidance to the residential area

confirm.zh: 降落点：居民区，跟着城市引导下去。确定吗？
confirm.en: Landing site: the residential area, following city guidance. Confirm?

ck_rope.zh: 铃烧了，手还是老往这儿伸。
ck_rope.en: The bell's gone, but my hand keeps reaching here.

ck_copilot.zh: 一直空着，我也一直在跟它说话。
ck_copilot.en: Always empty. I keep talking to it anyway.

ck_cabinet.zh: 每一格，我都知道放的是什么。
ck_cabinet.en: I know what's in every slot.

ck_tools.en: The one I use most, on the left.

ck_drawing.zh: 耳朵画小了。缺口是后来补的。
ck_drawing.en: Drew the ears too small. Added the notch later.

ending1._note: 11-02 作者：窗外开云、降落那几张很奇怪，「还是老样子加速飞走然后黑屏切换」——和飞行一结尾同一套往前一冲

yard_sign.zh: 指示牌：「饮水处，大型动物」，箭头往东。
yard_sign.en: Sign: "Watering hole, large animals." The arrow points east.

e1_meet.en: I've been looking for you for a long time.

e1_meet.zh: 背包别放那么近，它爱翻有吃的味道的袋子。
e1_meet.en: Don't keep your bag so close. It likes digging through anything that smells like food.
Not this. It's the last of it.

options.en: So you're this loud when you eat.
Can I watch you a little longer?

options.zh: 我还以为，见到你以后会有很多话。
options.en: I thought I'd have so much to say when I met you.
I'm your mom.

options.zh: 你认识一只鹿吗？它管我叫孩子。
options.en: Do you know a deer? It calls me its kid.

e1_ch_a.zh: 它一直这样，隔着半条河都听得见。
e1_ch_a.en: Always is. You can hear it from across the river.

e1_ch_c.en: ...And now I can't think of a single thing.

e1_sit.zh: 我一直以为，找到它以后，我一定会高兴得不得了。
e1_sit.en: I always thought that once I found it, I'd be over the moon.

e1_sit.zh: 刚才确实挺高兴。现在腿有点麻，还有点饿。
e1_sit.en: And I was, just now. Now my legs are asleep, and I'm a bit hungry.

e1_sit.zh: 吃的话，往那边走，有个小摊。
e1_sit.en: If you want food, there's a stall that way.
I'm going to get something to eat. You carry on.

e1_note.zh: 回去以后，照实告诉弥洛。
e1_note.en: When I get back, I'll tell Milo straight.

e1_plant_ask.en: The damp soil by the water's fine.

e1_passerby_chat.en: It's not afraid of people. Doesn't care about them either.

e1_paper_get.zh: 日记烧了，跟路过的人借了张纸。
e1_paper_get.en: The journal's gone. Borrowed a sheet from the passerby.

e1_write.zh: 今天找到大象了：左耳有缺口，吃草很响，会翻袋子。
e1_write.en: Found the elephant today: notch in the left ear, loud when it eats grass, goes through bags.

narr.zh: 第一页上还是那句：「我一定要找到大象，因为」
narr.en: The first page still says: "I have to find the elephant, because"

ending2._note: 11-02 作者：窗外开云、降落那几张很奇怪，「还是老样子加速飞走然后黑屏切换」——和飞行一结尾同一套往前一冲

options.en: It's grey. Bigger than a house.

options.zh: 你们是不是都基因突变了？
options.en: Did you all get some kind of mutation?
Can you see me, then?

e2_footage.zh: 画面里是有，可眼前没有啊。
e2_footage.en: It's there in the footage. But not in front of us.

e2_explain.zh: 你画的这个我认得，可我眼前就是一块草地啊。
e2_explain.en: I know what you've drawn. But all I see is grass.
Sit down for a bit. Have some water.
I can see it right now.

options.zh: 你可以再陪我站一会儿吗？
options.en: Could you stand here with me a little longer?
I want to write down where it is first.
Just leave the water there. Thanks.

e2_ch_a.en: Sure. I've got nothing else on.

e2_dusk.zh: 我该回去了。飞机要帮忙的话，我白天过来。
e2_dusk.en: I should head back. If the ship needs a hand, I'll come by in the day.

e2_elephant_chat.en: Only I can see it. It's still there.

e2_paper_get.zh: 日记烧了，跟那个居民借了张纸。
e2_paper_get.en: The journal's gone. Borrowed a sheet from the resident.

e2_write.zh: 位置：居民区外，缓坡下的树旁。往水边走。
e2_write.en: Location: outside the residential area, by the tree at the foot of the slope. Heads for the water.
Sound: once at dusk, lower than the wind.

e2_night._note: 11-04 夜测：原来躺在飞船身上（穿模），先走到船左边的空地再躺

e2_night.zh: 早上，大象从机翼后面过去。
e2_night.en: Morning: the elephant walked past behind the wing.

e2_night.zh: 来帮忙的：昨天坐在旁边的那位居民。
e2_night.en: Helping: the resident who sat with me yesterday.
The wing still needs one more bracket.

ending3._note: 11-02 作者：窗外开云、降落那几张很奇怪，「还是老样子加速飞走然后黑屏切换」——和飞行一结尾同一套往前一冲

ending3.zh: 你在找大象？它今天一直在喷泉那边。
ending3.en: Looking for the elephant? It's been by the fountain all day.

ending3.zh: 走吧，飞机我们帮你固定。
ending3.en: Come on. We'll tie down your ship.

town_basket.en: It knocked that over just now.

options.en: I see it! ...It's your hand.

options.zh: 我是它妈妈，叫一声它就过来了。
options.en: I'm its mom. It'll come if I call.

options.zh: 你们是不是在拿我开玩笑？
options.en: Are you all pulling my leg?

e3_ask.zh: 大家看到的，是这一头吗？
e3_ask.en: Is this the one you're all seeing?

e3_ask.zh: 是是是！刚才它还把鼻子伸进喷泉里！
e3_ask.en: Yes, yes! It just stuck its trunk in the fountain!

e3_ask.zh: 今天先回去歇着吧。明天再来。
e3_ask.en: Go get some rest today. Come back tomorrow.

e3_touch._note: 11-04 夜测：原来淡入在喷泉正中，站在池子里（穿模）

e3_paper_get.zh: 日记烧了，跟住处的人借了几张纸。
e3_paper_get.en: The journal's gone. Borrowed a few sheets from the lodging.

e3_write1.zh: 今天，我终于见到了大象
e3_write1.en: Today I finally met the elephant
At least, that's what they all say

narr.zh: 门外有人喊：「今天它跟你可亲了！」
narr.en: Someone calls from outside the door: "It was so sweet on you today!"

e3_confess.zh: 昨天我伸手的时候，手心里是空的。
e3_confess.en: Yesterday, when I reached out, my hand touched nothing.
Huh? Then... are we still going?

e3_confess._note: 11-04 夜测：原来淡入在喷泉正中，站在池子里（穿模）

e3_listen.en: They say it's swinging its nose

e3_listen.zh: 昨天，我们以为你真摸到了，大家才那么高兴。
e3_listen.en: Yesterday we thought you'd really touched it. That's why everyone was so happy.

e3_listen.zh: 我知道。我也想让你们高兴。
e3_listen.en: I know. I wanted you to be happy, too.

e3_listen.zh: 而且，都走了这么远，我不太敢说还是没找到。
e3_listen.en: And after coming all this way, I couldn't bring myself to say I still hadn't found it.

options.en: I want to look on my own for a while.
I need to fix what I wrote yesterday.

options.zh: 你可以陪着，但先别告诉我该看见什么。
options.en: You can stay, but don't tell me what I should see.

e3_ch_b.zh: 改吧，昨天是我们太急了。
e3_ch_b.en: Fix it. We rushed you yesterday.

e3_wait.en: I'll sit here and wait for you.

e3_bench.zh: 我今天看见的还是那块空地。
e3_bench.en: All I saw today was the same empty ground.

e3_seed_ask.zh: 广场外有一小块花圃，上午晒得到太阳。
e3_seed_ask.en: There's a little flower bed outside the plaza. Gets the morning sun.

e3_seedless.zh: 能借我几张纸吗？有些话要带回去给弥洛。
e3_seedless.en: Could I borrow a few sheets? There's something I need to take back to Milo.

e3_night.match: 今天，我终于见到了大象

e3_night.zh: 昨天我看见一块空地，伸出去的手也落了空，那时候不好意思说。
e3_night.en: Yesterday I saw empty ground and my hand reached into nothing, and I was too embarrassed to say so.

e3_night.zh: 今天：喷泉这边、另一侧、云台尽头、长椅旁边，都看过。
e3_night.en: Today: this side of the fountain, the other side, the end of the cloud pier, by the bench. Looked at all of it.

e3_night.zh: （画了喷泉的形状）下次换一条路线。
e3_night.en: (a sketch of the fountain) Try a different route next time.
Sure. Can I get salty bread?
I'll save you a crusty end.

narr.zh: 导航屏：预计抵达时间待定。
narr.en: Nav screen: arrival time to be determined.

ending4.zh: 我还是想下去，也还是想收到她的消息。
ending4.en: I still want to go down. I still want to hear from her.

e4_musicbox.zh: 又错了。从前一个音再来。
e4_musicbox.en: Wrong again. From the note before.

e4_page_loose.en: ...I'll write on the back of the chart.

narr.zh: 第一页：「我一定要找到大象，因为」
narr.en: The first page: "I have to find the elephant, because"

e4_write.zh: 坐标：云层之上，安全漂行轨道。
e4_write.en: Position: above the clouds, safe drift orbit.

e4_write.zh: 要修：右侧接口，慢慢漏气。
e4_write.en: To fix: right-side joint, slow leak.

e4_write.zh: （空着，圈了几处最近能补给的地方。）
e4_write.en: (Blank, with a few nearby supply stops circled.)

epilogue.spec: 【以下为四个结局后的条件尾声，呈现晨后来回访时的片段，不表示飞机在结局后立即修好。大象的结局改变晨带回的描述，物品状态改变相关动作和局部对白。】

epilogue._note: 11-04 夜测：人在黑幕里先站好，淡入以后不再凭空冒出来

epilogue.zh: 这地图得改改吧？后面要是还有人来，咱可不能再照着带。
epilogue.en: This map needs fixing, doesn't it? If anyone else comes through, I can't go leading them by it.

epi_deer_e1.zh: 见到了。吃草很响，不怎么理人。
epi_deer_e1.en: I did. Loud when it eats. Doesn't pay anyone much mind.

epi_deer_e2.zh: 见到了。我能看见，别人都看不见。
epi_deer_e2.en: I did. I can see it. Nobody else can.
Then I believe you saw it.

epi_deer_e3.zh: 他们都说它在那儿，可我眼前一直是空地。
epi_deer_e3.en: They all said it was there. All I ever saw was empty ground.

epi_deer_e3.zh: 那你就说看不见。看不见又不丢人。
epi_deer_e3.en: Then say you can't see it. Not seeing it's nothing to be ashamed of.

epi_deer_e4.zh: 停在云上了，先回来看看。
epi_deer_e4.en: I stopped above the clouds. Came back first.
Stopping's fine. The road's not going anywhere.

epi_deer_drawing._note: 11-05：新第一关把路标送回空地的支线 flag（原来是旧版的 returned_all）

epi_deer_sign.zh: 你还的那个路标，到现在一直指着云那边。
epi_deer_sign.en: That signpost you gave back still points at the clouds.

epi_deer_rock2.zh: 空地石头上那头，画得也不准。
epi_deer_rock2.en: The one on the rock in the clearing isn't drawn right either.

epi_deer_chat.zh: 下回来，先在路口喊一声，咱听得见。
epi_deer_chat.en: Next time, give a shout at the crossroads. I'll hear.

epi_miluo._note: 11-02 河流篇来客册改成可选：没描杯底记号（river_cup_traced）就不递纸，直接问种子

epi_miluo_cup.zh: 来客册里抄的。你那位朋友到过河流城市，寄过信，可北岸的邮箱被水冲走了。
epi_miluo_cup.en: Copied from the guestbook. Your friend came through the river city and sent letters, but the north-bank mailbox washed away.

epi_miluo_cup.zh: 挑个不会掉进河里的邮箱，很难吗？
epi_miluo_cup.en: Was it that hard to pick a mailbox that wouldn't fall in the river?

epi_miluo_planted.zh: 湿土。浇过了，没挖出来看。
epi_miluo_planted.en: Damp. Watered it. Didn't dig it up to check.
Fine. That's all I wanted to ask.

epi_miluo_kept.zh: 那就继续好好放着。别一脸现在就要交作业的样子。
epi_miluo_kept.en: Then keep it safe. And stop looking like you're handing in homework.

epi_miluo_burned.zh: 种子我烧了。燃料不够，我算了好几遍。
epi_miluo_burned.en: I burned the seed. Not enough fuel. I counted again and again.

epi_miluo_burned.zh: 你倒是终于知道，难听的话也得当面说了。
epi_miluo_burned.en: So you've finally learned to say the hard stuff to someone's face.

epi_miluo_burned.zh: 递过来啊，站那儿干吗，光都给你挡住了。
epi_miluo_burned.en: Hand it over, then. Don't just stand there, you're in my light.

epi_miluo_end._note: 11-05：新第一关把收音机送回小吃棚的支线 flag（原来是旧版的 returned_any）

epi_miluo_returned.zh: 那只鹿说，小吃棚的收音机前几天自己响了。八成是风。
epi_miluo_returned.en: The deer says the radio at the snack shed switched itself on the other day. Probably the wind.

epi_miluo_chat.en: Sit if you're sitting. Not that one.

epi_niff._note: 11-04 夜测：人在黑幕里先站好，淡入以后不再凭空冒出来

epi_niff_e1.zh: 找到了。吃草的时候很响，不怎么理人。
epi_niff_e1.en: I found it. Loud when it eats. Doesn't pay anyone much mind.

epi_niff_e2.zh: 找到了。可只有我看得见。
epi_niff_e2.en: I found it. But only I can see it.

epi_niff_e2.zh: 那这个也写上。别人没看见，也是发生过的事呀。
epi_niff_e2.en: Then write that down too. Even if nobody else saw it, it still happened.

epi_niff_e3.zh: 我眼前一直是一块空地，他们都说它在。
epi_niff_e3.en: All I saw was empty ground. They all said it was there.

epi_niff_e4.zh: 我还没下去，停在云层上面了。
epi_niff_e4.en: I haven't gone down yet. I stopped above the clouds.
Wow. A ship asleep on the clouds.

epi_niff_nofootage.zh: 影像我烧掉了，记不清的地方就空着。
epi_niff_nofootage.en: I burned the footage. Whatever I can't remember, I've left blank.

epi_niff_bell.zh: 你本子第一页这里空着，是忘了吗？
epi_niff_bell.en: The first page of your notebook's blank here. Did you forget?
I don't know this part either.

epi_niff_bell.zh: 那先放着嘛。你哪天知道了，再告诉我呀。
epi_niff_bell.en: Then leave it for now. Tell me when you know.
I'm not big on sweet things.

epi_niff_bell.zh: 啊，拿错啦。这个才是你的。
epi_niff_bell.en: Ah, wrong one. This one's yours.

epi_niff_chat.zh: 这页写着：晨，回来过。这次没写成湿湿的人。
epi_niff_chat.en: This page says: Chen, came back. Didn't write you as the soggy one this time.

narr.zh: 第一页：「我一定要找到大象，因为」
narr.en: The first page: "I have to find the elephant, because"

final_soup_fuel.zh: 那袋浮木换成汤了，表上少了一截。
final_soup_fuel.en: Traded the driftwood for soup. The gauge is a notch lower.

final_niff_msg_plain._note: 11-02 这两段里按河流篇的称呼分了四个 if，不再算「播完回来」的分支，播完显式接回去

final_nifu1_plain_p.zh: 晨，本子上写着你喝过茶啦，那现在呢，喝上热的了吗？
final_nifu1_plain_p.en: Chen, my notebook says you had tea. What about now, got something hot?

reply.en: Not yet. Nowhere to boil water out here.

final_nifu1_plain_c.zh: 取件员，本子上写着你喝过茶啦，那现在呢，喝上热的了吗？
final_nifu1_plain_c.en: Courier, my notebook says you had tea. What about now, got something hot?

reply.en: Not yet. Nowhere to boil water out here.

final_niff_msg_soup._note: 11-02 这两段里按河流篇的称呼分了四个 if，不再算「播完回来」的分支，播完显式接回去

final_nifu1_soup_p.zh: 晨，本子上写着你喝过茶啦，那现在呢，喝上热的了吗？
final_nifu1_soup_p.en: Chen, my notebook says you had tea. What about now, got something hot?

reply.zh: 喝了。鼠妈的汤，还是热的。
reply.en: I did. Mama Rat's soup. Still warm.

final_nifu1_soup_c.zh: 取件员，本子上写着你喝过茶啦，那现在呢，喝上热的了吗？
final_nifu1_soup_c.en: Courier, my notebook says you had tea. What about now, got something hot?

reply.zh: 喝了。鼠妈的汤，还是热的。
reply.en: I did. Mama Rat's soup. Still warm.

look_toucan_feather.zh: 大嘴鸟最好的一根羽毛。

look_recipe_card.zh: 鼠妈的菜谱：「火别太大，等它自己滚。」
look_recipe_card.en: Mama Rat's recipe: "Not too hot. Let it come to a boil on its own."

look_bird_whistle.zh: 转音那里，它还是会等一下。
look_bird_whistle.en: Where the tune turns, it still waits a moment.

epi_niff_stove.zh: 对了，高处市集那口灶，听说一直没熄过。
epi_niff_stove.en: Oh, right. They say that stove up at the high market has never gone out.

epi_home_recipe.zh: 照鼠妈的菜谱煮过一锅，火太大了。
epi_home_recipe.en: Made a pot from Mama Rat's recipe. Heat was too high.

look_family_photo.zh: 这些脸，我好像快想起来了。

look_rabbit_fur.en: The rabbit's fur. Not all gone yet.

look_floorboard.zh: 弥洛从自己家地上撬下来的。
look_floorboard.en: Milo pried it up from her own floor.

cab_burned_bear.zh: 已经烧掉的：小鹿的玩具熊。
cab_burned_bear.en: Already burned: the deer's teddy bear.

e1_ch_mom.zh: 上一个这么跟它说的，被喷了一身水。
e1_ch_mom.en: The last person who told it that got hosed down.

e1_ch_kid.zh: ……这附近的动物，认亲都挺随便的。
e1_ch_kid.en: ...Animals round here aren't too fussy about family.

e2_see_a.zh: 灰色的、比房子还大……你说的是那块石头吧？它在那儿三十年了。
e2_see_a.en: Grey, bigger than a house... You mean that rock? It's been there thirty years.

e2_see_c.en: I can. You've got dirt on your face.

e3_pl_b.zh: 那您快叫！它刚把李婶的帽子吃了。
e3_pl_b.en: Then call it, quick! It just ate Auntie Li's hat.

e3_pl_c.zh: 开这种玩笑，我们图什么呀？
e3_pl_c.en: What would we get out of a joke like that?

epi_hi_mom.zh: 妈妈！你不在的时候，咱天天孝敬你，给你的飞机坑浇水。
epi_hi_mom.en: Mama! While you were gone I honored you every day. I watered your crash crater.

epi_hi_child.zh: 孩子，回来啦。外头的路，难走不？
epi_hi_child.en: You're back, kid. Rough out there?

epi_niff_name_p.zh: 晨！要去云层星找大象的晨！
epi_niff_name_p.en: Chen! Chen who's going to the cloud planet to find the elephant!

epi_niff_name_c.zh: 取件员晨！你的件我还没找到，再等等。
epi_niff_name_c.en: Chen the courier! I still haven't found your package. Hang on.
